publishedMetadata.title: Controlled vs uncontrolled inputs
publishedMetadata.description: Distinguish a React-controlled input from an uncontrolled field registered with React Hook Form, and keep a single source of truth. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Distinguish a React-controlled input from an uncontrolled field registered with React Hook Form, and keep a single source of truth.
Type `Practice HTTP` using the keyboard and submit; the output must reflect the text. Submitting an empty or two-character title must not update the output.
The browser must validate for usability, but the HTTP server still checks the 3–100 character title and allowed priorities.
